extracted.intended_audience: State educational agencies (SEAs), local educational agencies (LEAs), institutions of higher education, nonprofit and community organizations, and other potential ESSA grant applicants/administrators
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance listing permissible uses of federal ESSA funds and eligible entities for various programs (e.g., Title I, III, IV), including programmatic requirements, recommended activities, and expectations for alignment with State academic standards and evaluation. Useful for preparing grant applications and designing funded programs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Alignment with challenging State academic standards
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensuring that any eligible entity that receives an award from the State aligns the activities provided by the program with the challenging State academic standards
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligible entities must align program activities to State academic standards and may identify and partner with external organizations; prescreened external organizations should be provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: Partnership with external organizations
rubrics_metrics.description: Eligible entities identify and partner with external organizations, if available in the community (external organizations: a nonprofit organization with a record of success in running or working with before and after school (or summer recess) programs and activities; or if none, a nonprofit that enters into a written agreement to receive mentoring and guidance)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State should provide a list of prescreened external organizations; partnerships may be required where appropriate to run or improve programs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Coordination of federal and state funds
rubrics_metrics.description: Coordinating funds received under this program with other Federal and State funds to implement high-quality programs
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should demonstrate plans to coordinate and align multiple funding streams to avoid duplication and maximize impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligible entity types (general)
rubrics_metrics.description: Eligible entities include institutions of higher education (IHEs); Indian tribes or tribal organizations; or one or more nonprofit entities in partnership with a high-need LEA, IHE, local government office of the chief elected official, or Indian tribe or tribal organization
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Multiple repeats indicate these are common allowable applicant configurations across programs; applicants should show required partnerships where applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Direct student services — academic tutoring
rubrics_metrics.description: Providing high-quality academic tutoring as a component of a personalized learning approach
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tutoring should be high-quality and part of a broader personalized learning strategy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Direct student services — accelerated and advanced coursework
rubrics_metrics.description: Providing accelerated coursework and advanced courses, including enrollment and participation in academic courses not otherwise available at a student’s school
rubrics_metrics.guidance: May include Advanced Placement, International Baccalaureate, or other advanced courses accepted for college credit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Career and technical education (CTE)
rubrics_metrics.description: Providing career and technical education coursework that is aligned with the challenging State academic standards; and leads to industry-recognized credentials that meet the quality criteria established by the State
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CTE must align to standards and lead to credentials meeting State quality criteria.

rubrics_metrics.name: Credit recovery and academic acceleration courses
rubrics_metrics.description: Credit recovery and academic acceleration courses that lead to a regular high school diploma
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Programs should result in credits applicable to a regular diploma.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reimbursement for college examination fees
rubrics_metrics.description: Reimbursing low-income students to cover part or all of the costs of fees for postsecondary-level instruction examinations that are accepted for credit at institutions of higher education (including AP and IB courses)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Funds may be used to reduce financial barriers for low-income students taking college-credit exams.

rubrics_metrics.name: Outreach and communication to parents
rubrics_metrics.description: Outreach and communication to parents about available direct student services in the LEA and State
rubrics_metrics.guidance: LEAs must inform families about services; effective outreach supports participation in programs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transportation for school transfer
rubrics_metrics.description: Transportation to allow a student enrolled in a school identified for comprehensive support and improvement to transfer to another public school (which may include a charter school) that has not been so identified by the State
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Transportation funds may support choice options for students in identified schools.

rubrics_metrics.name: After-school activities
rubrics_metrics.description: Programs that provide after-school activities for students who are English learners that emphasize language skills and academic achievement
rubrics_metrics.guidance: After-school programs should emphasize both language development and academic progress.

rubrics_metrics.name: Early childhood education programs
rubrics_metrics.description: Providing early childhood education programs for eligible children
rubrics_metrics.guidance: May include coordination of families, program staff, principals, instructional support personnel, and teachers in literacy development from birth through kindergarten.

rubrics_metrics.name: Family involvement in early literacy
rubrics_metrics.description: Coordinating the involvement of families, early childhood education program staff, principals, other school leaders, specialized instructional support personnel, and teachers in literacy development of children from birth through kindergarten
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Activities should be coordinated across stakeholders to support early literacy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preparation for early college/dual enrollment
rubrics_metrics.description: Developing, or assisting LEAs in developing, strategies that provide teachers, principals, or other school leaders with the skills, credentials, or certifications needed to educate all students in postsecondary education coursework through early college high school or dual or concurrent enrollment programs
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Focus on educator preparation to support college-level instruction in secondary settings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Instructional support for English learners — tutorials and CTE
rubrics_metrics.description: Providing to English learners tutorials and academic or career and technical education
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supports should be tailored to EL needs and may include academic and career pathways.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dual/concurrent enrollment for English learners
rubrics_metrics.description: Offering early college high school or dual or concurrent enrollment programs or courses designed to help English learners achieve success in postsecondary education
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Courses must be appropriate to ELs' needs and aligned with postsecondary expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Enhanced instructional opportunities for immigrant children and youth
rubrics_metrics.description: Enhanced instructional opportunities, which may include family literacy, parent and family outreach, and training activities designed to assist parents and families to become active participants in the education of their children
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Programs may include recruitment/support for personnel trained to serve immigrants, tutorials, mentoring, counseling, curricular materials, and coordinated community services.

rubrics_metrics.name: Instructional materials and technology for immigrant programs
rubrics_metrics.description: Identification, development, and acquisition of curricular materials, educational software, and technologies to be used in the program carried out with awarded funds
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Materials should support instructional goals for immigrant children and youth.

rubrics_metrics.name: Basic instructional services attributable to immigrant children
rubrics_metrics.description: Basic instructional services directly attributable to the presence of immigrant children and youth in the LEA, including payment of additional classroom supplies, costs of transportation, or other directly attributable costs
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Funds may cover incremental costs arising from immigrant student needs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Orientation and civics education for immigrant students
rubrics_metrics.description: Programs of introduction to the educational system and civics education designed to assist immigrant children and youth
rubrics_metrics.guidance: May be offered as part of broader supports to facilitate school integration and civic understanding.

rubrics_metrics.name: Coordinated community services for immigrant families
rubrics_metrics.description: Activities, coordinated with community-based organizations, IHEs, private sector entities, or other entities with expertise in working with immigrants, to assist parents and families by offering comprehensive community services
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Coordination with external partners is encouraged to provide wraparound supports.

rubrics_metrics.name: Intensified instruction for English learners
rubrics_metrics.description: Providing to English learners intensified instruction, which may include materials in a language that the student can understand, interpreters, and translators
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Instructional supports should be linguistically accessible and appropriately intensive.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of educational technology for English learners
rubrics_metrics.description: Improving the instruction of English learners by providing for the acquisition or development of educational technology or instructional materials, and by providing for access to electronic networks for materials, training, and communication
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Technology should be incorporated into curricula and programs to support EL instruction and assessment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Instructional program improvement for English learners
rubrics_metrics.description: Improving the instructional program for English learners by identifying, acquiring, and upgrading curricula, instructional materials, educational software, and assessment procedures
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Programs should demonstrate effectiveness in increasing English proficiency and academic achievement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Language instruction educational programs (LIEPs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Increasing English language proficiency by providing effective language instruction educational programs that meet the needs of English learners and demonstrate success in increasing English language proficiency and student academic achievement
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Programs must be effective and coordinated with other relevant programs and services.

rubrics_metrics.name: Parent, family, and community engagement for English learners
rubrics_metrics.description: Providing and implementing activities and strategies that enhance or supplement language instruction educational programs, including community participation programs, family literacy services, and parent and family outreach and training activities
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Engagement strategies may include coordination and alignment of related programs and services to help families support students' academic achievement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recognition for significant improvement in EL outcomes
rubrics_metrics.description: Providing recognition, which may include financial awards, to recipients of subgrants that have significantly improved the achievement and progress of English learners in meeting State-designed long-term goals and challenging State academic standards
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognition may be used to incentivize measurable gains including interim progress measurements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Standardized statewide entrance and exit procedures for ELs
rubrics_metrics.description: Establishing and implementing standardized statewide entrance and exit procedures, including a requirement that all students who may be English learners are assessed for such status within 30 days of enrollment
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedures must be developed with timely and meaningful consultation with geographically diverse LEAs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Teacher and principal preparation for EL education
rubrics_metrics.description: Providing effective teacher and principal preparation, effective professional development activities, and other activities that may include assisting educators in meeting State and local certification and licensing requirements for teaching English learners
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Preparation should improve teaching skills for diverse EL needs and support implementation of effective programs and curricula.

rubrics_metrics.name: Technical assistance to subgrantees serving ELs
rubrics_metrics.description: Providing technical assistance to eligible entities receiving subgrants, including help in identifying and implementing effective language instruction educational programs and in helping English learners meet challenging State academic standards and measures of English proficiency
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assistance may include strengthening parent engagement and developing measures of English proficiency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Professional development intensity and duration
rubrics_metrics.description: Providing effective professional development to teachers, principals, administrators, and other personnel that is of sufficient intensity and duration (which shall not include activities such as 1-day or short-term workshops and conferences) to have a positive and lasting impact
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Exception: a one-day activity may be a component of a long-term comprehensive PD plan established by a teacher and supervisor based on assessed needs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Professional development goals
rubrics_metrics.description: PD designed to improve instruction and assessment of English learners, enhance ability to implement curricula and instructional strategies, and be effective in increasing English language proficiency or substantially increasing subject matter and teaching knowledge
rubrics_metrics.guidance: PD may include developing curricula, sharing effective practices (including technology-based programs), and strengthening parent/community engagement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support for educator certification and coursework
rubrics_metrics.description: In conjunction with other Federal need-based student financial assistance programs, providing financial assistance and costs related to tuition, fees, and books for enrolling in courses required to complete degrees or meet certification/licensing requirements for teachers who work in language instruction educational programs or serve English learners
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Funds may support in-service education to build capacity among educators serving ELs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Upgrading program objectives and instructional strategies
rubrics_metrics.description: Upgrading program objectives and effective instructional strategies for programs serving English learners
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should propose objective upgrades tied to measurable improvement in EL outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Environmental literacy programs
rubrics_metrics.description: Support for environmental literacy programs (listed as a permissible use)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: May be funded under certain programs (e.g., 21st Century Community Learning Centers).

rubrics_metrics.name: Improving equitable access to effective teachers
rubrics_metrics.description: Identifying and addressing disparities that result in low-income students and minority students being taught at higher rates than other students by ineffective, inexperienced, or out-of-field teachers
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Activities should reduce inequities in teacher assignment and distribution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Equitable per-pupil funding (weighted allocations)
rubrics_metrics.description: Providing LEAs with flexibility to consolidate eligible Federal funds and State and local education funding to create a single school funding system based on weighted per-pupil allocations for low-income and otherwise disadvantaged students
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supports targeted resource allocation based on student need.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program evaluation and comprehensive evaluation
rubrics_metrics.description: Evaluating programs and activities, including conducting a comprehensive evaluation (directly, or through a grant or contract) of the effectiveness of programs and activities
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should include plans for evaluation and evidence of effectiveness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Design and implementation of educator evaluation and support systems
rubrics_metrics.description: Developing, improving, or providing assistance to LEAs to support the design and implementation of teacher, principal, or other school leader evaluation and support systems that are based in part on evidence of student academic achievement and include multiple measures of educator performance
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Systems must provide clear, timely, and useful feedback, may include student growth measures, classroom observation rubrics, training for inter-rater reliability, and auditing quality of systems.

rubrics_metrics.name: Training evaluators and using evaluation to inform decisions
rubrics_metrics.description: Developing and providing training to principals, other school leaders, coaches, mentors, and evaluators on how to accurately differentiate performance, provide useful and timely feedback, and use evaluation results to inform decisionmaking about professional development, improvement strategies, and personnel decisions
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Training should enable accurate observations, reliable ratings, and productive feedback cycles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ongoing differentiated support based on evaluations
rubrics_metrics.description: Developing or improving a rigorous, transparent, and fair evaluation and support system that provides teachers, principals, or other school leaders with ongoing, differentiated, targeted, and personalized support and feedback for improvement, including professional development opportunities
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Support should be tied to evaluation findings and aimed at increasing educator effectiveness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Stakeholder outreach for evaluation systems
rubrics_metrics.description: Conducting outreach within an LEA or a State to gain input on how to construct an evaluation and support system and to develop support for the system, including training personnel in how to observe and evaluate teachers
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Inclusive consultation is expected to ensure buy-in and appropriate design.

rubrics_metrics.name: Principal autonomy for school-level decisions
rubrics_metrics.description: Providing principals or other school leaders with balanced autonomy to make budgeting, scheduling, and other school-level decisions in a manner that meets the needs of the school without compromising the intent or essential components of LEA or State policies
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Autonomy should be balanced and aligned with broader policy goals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Principal authority for staffing decisions
rubrics_metrics.description: Providing principals or other school leaders with authority to make staffing decisions that meet the needs of the school, such as building an instructional leadership team that includes teacher leaders or offering opportunities for teams or pairs of effective teachers to teach together in high-need schools
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Staffing authority should be used to strengthen school leadership and instruction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Performance-based compensation for school leaders
rubrics_metrics.description: Implementing, as part of a comprehensive performance-based compensation system, a differentiated salary structure, which may include bonuses and stipends, to principals or other school leaders who serve in high-need schools and raise student academic achievement
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Compensation systems should be part of a comprehensive approach tied to student outcomes.
